text: China's industrial profits rise 20.1% YoY in October. January-October electronics profits double and high-tech manufacturing profits rise 50.9%, while automotive, construction materials and furniture profits decline 26%, 46.7% and 52.4%, respectively.

meta.note: Profit contraction does not establish equivalent contraction in physical production or operational capacity.

text: Norse Atlantic Airways AS files a bankruptcy petition with Agder District Court. Short-term liquidity requirements remain unmet, all flights are cancelled and ticket sales discontinued. The listed parent company and UK subsidiary remain outside the reported filing.

meta.note: Bankruptcy petition is distinct from completed liquidation; the remaining group entities' status is unresolved.
